_purpose: Exact peerDependencies declared by the two Sanity packages currently in this repo's dependency tree, extracted directly from pnpm-lock.yaml (not inferred). This is the ground truth for how tight package.json's react/react-dom ranges must be. If sanity or @sanity/vision are ever bumped to a new version, re-extract this file from the new pnpm-lock.yaml before trusting it — RF-06 in the contract cross-checks the live lockfile against these exact strings and will fail loudly if they drift.

@sanity/vision.note: declares its own sanity peer range independently of the sanity package's own version — currently satisfied (5.31.1 falls inside ^5.0.0-0), no action needed there. The react@^19.2.2 peer is the one that matters for this fix.

minimum_required_project_range.rationale: package.json must declare a range whose MINIMUM satisfiable version is >= 19.2.2 so that a fresh/frozen install can never resolve an older React lacking React.useEffectEvent, which sanity@5.31.1's Structure Tool calls directly (confirmed via grep of node_modules/sanity/lib/_chunks-es/structureTool.js — the prior fix in commit 397de87 claimed to remove this call but did not).
